# SB Heartbeat

> A safety-focused CLI for keeping intentionally retained Supabase projects active with a fixed, read-only heartbeat.

SB Heartbeat uses a Supabase project URL and a low-privilege publishable or legacy anon key. It never needs a database password, secret key, service-role key, or Management API token. The CLI generates guarded migration SQL, validates configuration and credentials before network access, and supports local or generated GitHub Actions execution.

Agent safety contract:

- Read and follow the downstream repository's existing instructions first.
- Use an exact, checksum-verified release.
- Configure environment-variable names, never credential values.
- Generate migration SQL; never apply it without explicit authorization and the repository's established migration process.
- Never modify a downstream repository's `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or equivalent instruction files.
- Never print, persist, or commit credential values.
- Never use or request a database password, Supabase secret key, service-role key, or Management API token.
- When the required low-privilege values are already available in the environment, run `doctor` before enabling a scheduler, then report all changed files and remaining manual steps.

## Essential documentation

- [README](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/README.md): Purpose, installation methods, commands, and documentation index.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): Smallest supported setup path for a person or agent.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): Strict YAML contract, derived bindings, GitHub sources, runtime bounds, and editor schema.
- [Security model](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/security.md): Least-privilege guarantees, credential rejection, fixed-query behavior, and threat boundaries.
- [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/github-actions.md): Pinned workflow generation and safe repository binding setup.
- [GitHub observability](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/github-observability.md): Opt-in sanitized annotations and retained result artifacts.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): Stable failures and corrective checks.
- [Product specification](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/product-spec.md): Authoritative product behavior, acceptance criteria, and 1.0 roadmap.

## Agent tasks

- [Agent installation guide](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/agent-install.md): Ordered installation procedure and prohibited actions.
- [Copyable agent prompts](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/agent-prompts.md): Prepare, verify, and local-cron tasks with bounded authority.
- [Coding-agent evaluation](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/agent-evaluation.md): Reproducible two-agent installation evidence and retained sanitized artifacts.

## Optional

- [Local cron](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/local-cron.md): Read-only cron suggestion generation, environment handling, logs, and monitoring.
- [Container](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/docker.md): Hardened local container build, read-only runtime, and multi-architecture verification.
- [Stop heartbeats and uninstall](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/uninstall.md): Scheduler-first offboarding, shared-binding checks, guarded SQL generation, and archive handoff.
- [Local status history](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/status-history.md): Opt-in bounded atomic snapshots with a deliberately sanitized schema.
- [Repeated-failure notifications](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/notifications.md): Thresholded HTTPS webhook events backed by private, durable, sanitized local state.
- [Prometheus metrics](https://github.com/croutoncreations/sb-heartbeat/blob/main/docs/metrics.md): Atomic sanitized current-result gauges for Prometheus textfile collectors.
